capabilities: sync WeRead highlights, thoughts and reviews into Markdown book notes
browse a bookshelf with search, categories and sync history
view reading statistics with heatmaps, rankings and category preferences
curate favorite highlights in list, card or Canvas views
apply built-in or custom templates to generated book notes
extras: Unofficial plugin (MIT) that does not download book content. One-way sync only; it never writes local edits back to WeRead, and normal sync regenerates note bodies only when highlight counts change. Cookie is additionally required for public-account article notes; some features need an API Key from the WeRead Skills page. Mobile support requires Obsidian 1.1.9+. Extensive further documentation lives outside the README.
motivation: The author states the project is an unofficial plugin meant to organize the reading records accessible from their own account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull highlights and annotations from the WeRead reading platform into vault notes.

relations.evidence: 把微信读书的划线、想法和书评同步到 Obsidian

summary: Syncs Tencent WeRead highlights, thoughts and reviews into Obsidian notes, with a bookshelf UI, reading statistics and a favorites canvas.
